What's your return and refund policy?
Happy to help. Here is a quick summary of our UK returns and refunds policy:
Free UK returns: Register your return with our online partner ZigZag, select the items and reason, then choose your preferred method (drop‑off or collection). You will receive a QR code or label by email once registered.
Return window: If you return an item within 30 days of receipt in its original condition, we will refund the amount you paid for it.
Sale items: Please register your return within 14 days of receipt via ZigZag, then you have a further 14 days to send it back, in original condition.
Items that cannot be refunded: Swimwear if the hygiene strip has been removed, and earrings if the internal packaging seal has been broken.
Refund timing: Returned parcels can take up to 14 days to reach us. We will email you when your return is processed, and your refund will appear within 5 working days from that point.
Orders with pre‑orders: If you return part of an order that also contains an outstanding pre‑order item, the cost of the outstanding item may be deducted from your refund, with the balance returned to your original payment method.
Exchanges: We do not offer exchanges. Please return your item for a refund and place a new order for the replacement.
You can find full details on our policy here: Returns and refunds
If you would like help getting a return started, tell me if your order was placed in the UK and I will guide you step by step.
